extraction.text:
KALYAN CHAKRAVARTHY

Senior Marketing & Brand Leader | Product Marketing, Eminence & GTM | B2B | 14+ Years

+91 9705444429 • kalyanillinda@gmail.com • linkedin.com/in/ikc29 • Hyderabad, India

EXECUTIVE PROFILE

Senior marketing leader with 16 years of experience building brand eminence, product and service positioning, and integrated go-to-market programmes across B2B technology and services organisations. Recognised for translating complex, multi-service propositions into compelling value narratives and pitch materials that generate trust, pipeline, and commercial impact across brand, content, digital, and demand functions. Proven ability to operate as the connective tissue between senior stakeholders, practice leads, and marketing execution, aligning positioning and GTM strategy to commercial priorities across NA and APAC markets. Experienced in executive engagement, sales enablement, cross-functional collaboration, and translating technical capabilities into clear business outcomes.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Brand Eminence & Market Positioning • Product Marketing & Value Propositions • Thought Leadership & Sector Content Strategy • GTM & Service Line Marketing • Pursuit Support & Sales Enablement • Executive & Stakeholder Engagement VOC Exposer Voice-of-Customer programmes Product requirements / user stories

Enterprise Demand Generation • Account-Based Marketing (ABM) • Marketing Automation (HubSpot • SFMC • Marketo) • Digital Growth & SEO/SEM • Marketing Analytics & ROI Attribution • Team Leadership & P&L Ownership

CAREER HIGHLIGHTS

✓ Built $10M marketing-sourced pipeline converting $5M+ to closed revenue, marketing recognised as primary

commercial growth driver at 35% of company targets

✓ Led enterprise-wide brand transformation (Evergent Brand 2.0), redefining identity, messaging architecture,

and digital presence to elevate market credibility and accelerate commercial positioning

✓ Grew LinkedIn organic engagement 30% in 6 months through practitioner-level sector narratives, shifting

brand voice from promotional to authoritative thought leadership

✓ Lifted MQL-to-SQL conversion 18% and email CTR 22% through precision audience segmentation and

persona-led campaign architecture

✓ Generated 43 qualified leads at 25% conversion through global event activations, Reuters Supply Chain

Summit (USA) and AWS ESG Summit (Singapore)

✓ Delivered 20-30 closed deals annually from integrated digital and content programmes, avg. deal size $20K-

$50K (Velosio, Microsoft Dynamics ecosystem)

I have exposure to the BFSI/financial-services domain, particularly around enterprise technology, SaaS,

data/analytics and digital transformation use cases.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Marketing Manager, Brand, Content & GTM | Zyter TruCare AI-powered care management SaaS platform serving payer and provider segments across US healthcare markets (~300 employees)

Jul 2024 / Apr 2026

◗ Owned end-to-end brand eminence and messaging architecture, developing value propositions, positioning frameworks, and narrative systems deployed across client-facing, digital, and internal stakeholder touchpoints.

◗ Built and managed a structured content engine producing 20+ assets annually, long-form thought

leadership, sector whitepapers, solution briefs, and video scripts, establishing the organisation as a credible

voice among healthcare payer and provider buyers.

◗ Led end-to-end commercialisation of enterprise technology solutions, translating product capabilities into differentiated positioning, GTM strategies, demand-generation programs, and revenue opportunities ◗ Deployed marketing performance dashboards tracking pipeline contribution, campaign ROI, and spend efficiency, providing senior leadership with their first integrated view of marketing's commercial impact. ◗ Developed 15+ pursuit support assets including playbooks, competitive battlecards, solution narratives, C-

suite presentations, and sales enablement materials, improving proposal win rates by 10-15% and compressing enterprise sales cycles.

◗ Architected full-funnel GTM strategy for three flagship product capabilities, translating product value into clinically relevant messaging and enabling client-facing teams to lead stronger stakeholder and buyer conversations.

◗ Lifted email engagement 22% and improved MQL-to-SQL conversion 18% through advanced persona

modelling and precision segmentation across digital, outbound, and event channels.

◗ Ran structured voice-of-customer and stakeholder feedback loops across payer and provider

engagements, consolidating recurring needs and pain points into prioritised insights to strengthen product messaging and GTM decisions.

◗ Partnered with Product, Operations, and Change stakeholders to translate customer and business

feedback into clear product requirements, user stories, and measurable value propositions, ensuring product capabilities aligned with stakeholder needs and adoption priorities.

◗ Supported product adoption initiatives through launch readiness, stakeholder communications,

enablement materials, and training inputs, tracking engagement and feedback to refine messaging and rollout plans.

◗ Led stakeholder engagements to present product capabilities, articulate business outcomes and

change impacts, address stakeholder concerns, and build advocacy for adoption across enterprise accounts.

Senior Marketing Manager, NA & APAC | Gramener (Data & Analytics SaaS)Jan 2023 / Dec 2023 Client- State Street AI-powered data storytelling and analytics platform serving Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, supply chain, and ESG verticals (~250 employees)

◗ Established the regional marketing function from zero, building brand positioning, product/service

messaging, eminence strategy, digital channels, and ABM programmes simultaneously across two international markets within 90 days of joining.

◗ Owned thought leadership and sector content programme, producing practitioner-level long-form content, executive narratives, and data-driven perspectives that positioned Gramener as a credible voice among Fortune 500 data and analytics buyers.

◗ Built and owned a $10M marketing-sourced pipeline, converting $5M+ in closed revenue at average deal sizes above $150K, making marketing the single largest commercial growth driver at 35% of company targets across NA and APAC.

◗ Launched targeted ABM programme engaging 20 strategic enterprise accounts, generating 4 qualified

opportunities through account-specific content and direct C-suite engagement programmes.

◗ Grew LinkedIn organic engagement 30% in 6 months by replacing promotional brand content with sector-

specific practitioner narratives that enterprise buyers actively shared and engaged with.

◗ Recruited and scaled a 15-member cross-functional team across demand generation, digital marketing, inside sales, content, and marketing operations, with full P&L accountability across a $75K programme budget.

◗ Activated global eminence through tier-1 event presence, Reuters Supply Chain Summit (USA) and AWS

ESG Summit (Singapore), generating 43 qualified leads at 25% conversion.

◗ Worked with State Street on BFSI-focused enterprise technology, data/analytics, and digital transformation initiatives, supporting business requirements and technology-enabled process improvements.

GTM & Brand Strategy Consultant | Independent Practice Dec 2023 / Jul 2024 Embedded marketing leadership for early-stage B2B SaaS companies, brand positioning, eminence strategy, and GTM architecture on a retained basis

◗ Designed brand positioning and messaging architecture for multiple B2B SaaS clients, producing

positioning documents, ICP definitions, value propositions, and messaging hierarchies that served as the strategic foundation for client-facing websites, sales narratives, and outbound programmes.

◗ Built content and demand generation programmes, editorial calendars, thought leadership strategy, email sequences, and LinkedIn content, delivering measurable organic traffic improvements and inbound lead quality within 60-90 days.

Marketing Manager, Brand & Digital Growth | Evergent (Subscription & Revenue Management SaaS) Dec 2020 / Jul 2022

Subscription and revenue management SaaS platform for media and entertainment enterprises (~400 employees)

◗ Led the Evergent Brand 2.0 transformation, redefining brand identity, visual standards, messaging

architecture, and tone of voice; rebuilt website UX around enterprise buyer intent, directly improving inbound quality and shortening the consideration stage.

◗ Owned full-channel digital marketing, SEO/SEM, paid digital, social, display, and email, with each channel

mapped to a specific stage of the enterprise buying journey and tracked against conversion targets.

◗ Contributed to 25% of company revenue objectives through 30+ integrated marketing programmes spanning digital, outbound, events, and customer engagement, a mix of marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline.

◗ Managed and mentored a multi-functional marketing team, improving campaign time-to-launch and

eliminating execution gaps that had previously caused missed market windows.

Marketing Manager | MOURI Tech (SAP & Oracle Enterprise Services) Nov 2019 / Dec 2020 Clients- S&P Global, Jefferies, and Lazard Enterprise technology services company specialising in SAP and Oracle implementation (~300 employees)

◗ Established the first formal marketing function, building brand voice, content workflows, and digital

infrastructure from scratch, transforming marketing from an ad-hoc activity into a structured commercial growth driver.

◗ Executed service-line GTM strategies for SAP and Oracle solutions, translating technical capabilities into compelling value propositions aligned with C-suite buyer priorities, contributing to 2-3 enterprise deal closures.

◗ Represented MOURI Tech at SAP Sapphire and ServiceNow, building brand presence among enterprise buyers and opening net-new commercial conversations with prospects previously unaware of the firm.

◗ Supported S&P Global, Jefferies, and Lazard on enterprise technology, SaaS, data/analytics, and

digital transformation use cases, partnering with stakeholders to identify requirements and deliver data- driven solutions.

Senior Marketing Lead | Velosio (Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Partner) Feb 2014 / Jul 2019 North America's largest Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM partner, serving SMB and mid-market accounts across North America (5+ year tenure)

◗ Managed integrated brand and demand programmes for Microsoft Dynamics 365, running SEO, paid digital, email, webinars, and social as coordinated acquisition channels across a North American SMB market. ◗ Generated 100+ qualified leads converting to 20-30 closed deals annually at average deal sizes of $20K-

$50K, through integrated digital, email, webinar, and content marketing programmes.

◗ Supported CEO thought leadership and executive branding, producing long-form content, campaign

narratives, and LinkedIn programmes that built Velosio's reputation as a thought leader in the Microsoft Dynamics ecosystem over five years.

EARLIER CAREER

Senior Marketing Executive | ValueLabs (OTT & Product Engineering Services) | Aug 2012 / Jan 2014 Established OTT product marketing function; drove Media & Entertainment brand campaigns, product positioning, competitive intelligence and content; supported pipeline development through account-based outreach.

Senior Business Development Executive | Aegis (Technology & Services) | Oct 2010 / Apr 2012 Drove MQL-to-SQL conversion programmes, built pipeline dashboards for leadership reporting, and conducted GTM competitive research, providing the commercial foundation for a 14-year marketing career.

EDUCATION

MBA, International Business Strategy , Indian Institute of Foreign Trade (IIFT) PG, Product Management , Duke University MA, Journalism & Mass Communications , BRAOU | B.Com (Computers) , Osmania University

CERTIFICATIONS

Google Campaigns Manager • Google Analytics 4 • HubSpot Digital Marketing • HubSpot Revenue Operations • Salesforce Admin (SFDC) • Salesforce Marketing Cloud Email • Microsoft CRM Certified
